title: A cosmic unit
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: A light-year is the distance light travels through a vacuum in one year. It is a unit of distance, even though its name contains a unit of time.

objective: Use the visual model to reason about: An astronomer says a star is 4 light-years away. What kind of quantity is a light-year?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: An astronomer says a star is 4 light-years away. What kind of quantity is a light-year? Distance. A light-year is the distance light travels through a vacuum in one year. It is a unit of distance, even though its name contains a unit of time.
Visual caption: Light-year = distance. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
